leagues.name: NBA
notes: All 30 clubs have 2026-27 jersey kits; 29 clubs have a verified patch partner with a source, Portland Trail Blazers has none (Zoomph, updated 2026-08-11, lists 'No Jersey Sponsor').
Patches are sponsors ON the jersey kit with placement 'patch' (issue #24 modelling).
Visit Rwanda (Rwanda Development Board) is the Clippers' exclusive jersey patch sponsor from 2025-26 (Clippers release, 29 Sep 2025).
League-level partners include Google (Official Fan Phone of the NBA, 2021) and Wilson (official game ball, 2021-22) - pr.nba.com releases.
LA Clippers x Visit Rwanda deal value not disclosed (Clippers release, 29 Sep 2025).

unsourced: Portland Trail Blazers 2026-27 patch conflict: the club named Brightside Windows official jersey patch partner on 30 Sep 2024 (nba.com/blazers, opened, https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/portland-trail-blazers-and-brightside-windows-announce-expansive-jersey-patch-partnership), but Zoomph's NBA patch guide (updated 2026-08-11, https://zoomph.com/blog/nba-jersey-patch-sponsors-this-season/) lists 'Portland Trail Blazers: No Jersey Sponsor' for 2026/27, and issue #24's closing comment also records the Blazers as without a 2026-27 patch partner. Whether the Brightside deal ended or continues is unconfirmed; no kit sponsor was added.

Zoomph's guide (updated 2026-08-11) conflicts with club announcements on three clubs: it lists 'Milwaukee Bucks: Motorola' (club announced ULINE on 21 Sep 2026, https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-name-wisconsin-based-uline-as-official-jersey-patch-partner), 'Utah Jazz: LiveView Technologies (LVT)' (club announced HealthEquity on 17 Jun 2026, https://utahjazz.com/news/healthequity-becomes-official-jersey-patch-partner-of-the-utah-jazz-1) and 'Sacramento kings: Phoong Law' (SBJ reported Sutter Health on 12 May 2026, https://sportsbusinessjournal.com/Articles/2026/05/12/sacramento-kings-name-sutter-health-jersey-patch-sponsor). Its per-team stats are labelled 2025/26 despite a 2026/27 intro, so the club announcements were taken as correct.

Phoenix Suns patch partner PayPal: the only season-current listing found is Zoomph's guide (updated 2026-08-11, 'Phoenix Suns: PayPal'); PayPal's own newsroom no longer lists the 2023 extension press release ('through the 2026 NBA season') and the original 2018 announcement URL is dead. A club-side 2026-27 source is still needed.

Golden State Warriors x IREN value: Sportico reported the sponsorship at about $50m a year per the Bay Area News Group report (https://siliconvalley.com/2026/06/27/warriors-announce-ai-data-center-company-as-jersey-sponsor, 27 Jun 2026); the club did not disclose terms, so the figure is a press estimate and not recorded in the deal.

IREN Ltd is described as Australia-based, vertically integrated AI cloud provider (Bay Area News Group, 27 Jun 2026); its NYSE listing and corporate structure were not independently confirmed from a primary filing in this pass.

Crypto.com's operating chain (Foris DAX Asia, Singapore; Foris DAX MT, Malta; Foris Holdings KY, Cayman Islands) rests on the OCC conditional trust-charter approval already recorded in normalized claims; Crypto.com's own legal/licences pages name no entities in fetchable text, so no fresh primary source was added.

JPMorganChase patch deal start date: the JPMorganChase newsroom release (8 Jul 2026, https://www.jpmorganchase.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/chasedallasmavs) says multi-year but shows no start season in fetchable text; 'from 2026' is inferred from the announcement date.

NBA league-level partner list for 2026-27: SportsPro's Commercial Guide page (https://www.sportspro.com/commercial-guide/nba/league-wide-partners/sponsors/) renders no sponsor names to fetchable content, and SBJ articles are paywalled; only Google (2021) and Wilson (2020) are recorded from pr.nba.com releases. The NBA had ~48-51 league marketing partners per SBJ (Dec 2021, Nov 2024) - the rest are unlisted here.

StockX source URL returns 403 to automated fetches (https://stockx.com/about/detroit-pistons-and-stockx-announce-jersey-partnership); content confirmed via fetch of the page text: multi-year deal, logo on front left chest from 2024-25 (published 25 Sep 2024).

Visit Rwanda is also an official tourism sponsor of the LA Rams, SoFi Stadium and Hollywood Park (same 29 Sep 2025 Clippers release); those NFL/sponsorship facts are out of this target's club-shirt scope and unrecorded.
